freeBets.noneAvailable: You have no free bets right now.
freeBets.noneArchived: No free bets have been played yet.

maximumWin.title: Maximum Win
maximumWin.body: The highest possible multiplier is 25,000x your bet. This is the absolute ceiling—even if the game continues beyond this point (theoretically), your payout caps at 25,000x.

minimumCashOut.title: Minimum Cash-Out (Free Bets Only)
minimumCashOut.body: When playing with free bets, a minimum cash-out multiplier applies (typically 1.50x, but configurable). You cannot cash out below this threshold when using promotional free bets.

placingBets.title: Placing Bets
placingBets.step1: Choose your bet amount using the +/- buttons or preset values (2.00, 5.00, 10.00, Max)
placingBets.step2: You can place up to two independent bets per round using the left and right betting panels
placingBets.step3: Press BET (purple button) to confirm your wager for the next comet launch
placingBets.step4: You have 6 seconds between rounds to place bets
placingBets.step5: When the comet launches and the multiplier starts rising, betting is locked until the next round

cashingOut.title: Cashing Out
cashingOut.step1: Click CASH OUT at any time during the match to secure your winnings
cashingOut.step3: If you place two bets, each has its own cash-out button
cashingOut.step4: If you fail to cash out before the comet explodes → your bet is lost
cashingOut.step5: After cashing out, wait until the round ends to bet again

multipliers.title: Top Banner — Recent Multipliers
multipliers.body: Shows the last exploded comet multipliers. Use this history to observe trends and guess when the next crash may occur.

balance.title: Balance Display
balance.body: Top-right live balance display showing your available funds.

panels.title: Betting Panels
panels.body: Two independent betting panels (left and right) allow you to:
panels.step3: Place one or two bets simultaneously
panels.step4: Cancel pending bets before the round starts

buttons.title: Action Buttons
buttons.step1: BET (Purple): Confirm your wager for the next round
buttons.step2: CANCEL (Red): Remove a pending bet before the round starts
buttons.step3: CASH OUT: Collect your winnings during an active round
buttons.step4: x2 Button: Double your current bet amount instantly

autoBet.title: Auto Bet
autoBet.body: Enable automatic betting by turning on the “Auto” switch. The system will place your chosen bet amount automatically each round without manual input.

autoCashOut.title: Auto Cash-Out
autoCashOut.body2: The game will automatically cash out when the comet reaches that point. Perfect for consistent and disciplined play.

autoplay.title: Autoplay Configuration
autoplay.body: Use advanced autoplay settings for hands-free gameplay:
autoplay.stopStep1: Stop on Total Win: End autoplay once total profit passes your limit
autoplay.stopStep2: Stop on Total Loss: Halt if losses exceed your chosen threshold
autoplay.stopStep3: Stop on Single Win: Stop after any bet wins above a certain amount

charts.title: History — Charts View
charts.body: Graphical display of past comet explosion multipliers, useful for reading volatility and patterns.

list.title: List View
list.body: A compact list of recent crash points in chronological order.

liveBets.title: Current Round Bets (Live Bets)
liveBets.body: Real-time display of all active bets from players currently in the match:
liveBets.step4: Who cashed out and who is still riding the comet
liveBets.footer: Adds transparency, social interaction, and competitive excitement.

myHistory.title: My History (Personal Bet History)
myHistory.step2: Multiplier: What multiplier you cashed out at (or crash point if you lost)
myHistory.step7: Round ID: Reference number for each game round
myHistory.footer: Filter and sort your history to track performance, review strategies, and monitor your bankroll management.

provablyFair.howItWorksBody: Our Provably Fair system uses several parameters to ensure complete transparency and fairness. Each round has both hidden and revealed states.
provablyFair.beforeGameBegins: Before the game begins, players can see:
provablyFair.provablyFairHashDescription: – A cryptographic hash that proves the round outcome was predetermined
provablyFair.note: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
provablyFair.onceRoundCompletes: Once the round completes, all parameters are revealed:
provablyFair.crashPointDescription: – The multiplier where the round ended
provablyFair.hashUnchangedDescription: – Remains the same, proving nothing changed
provablyFair.fourParametersIntro: Every round uses these four elements:
provablyFair.serverKeyParameter: – Random string generated by the server
provablyFair.crashPointParameter: – The multiplier where the round crashes
provablyFair.hashParameter: – SHA-512 hash of the combined data
provablyFair.formula: Provably Fair Hash = SHA512(ServerKey + "." + CrashPoint + "." + RoundNumber)
